title: Dynamic Price Competition and Evolutionary Behavior with Search
title_zh: 搜索条件下的动态价格竞争与演化行为
title_primary: 搜索条件下的动态价格竞争与演化行为
title_secondary: Dynamic Price Competition and Evolutionary Behavior with Search
authors: Blake Allison, Michael Sacks
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a model of dynamic pricing with boundedly rational consumer search. Consumers observe one price, can choose to engage in costly search to learn the other prices, and then purchase from the firm with the lowest observed price. Each consumer searches only if the observed price exceeds their dynamically tuned reservation price. Firms optimize given the current distribution of reservation prices. Short run pricing is characterized by Edgeworth cycles. Rather than resetting as a mixed strategy, each cycle resets when the firm with the larger installed base relents by monopolizing its residual demand. Both the lower and upper bounds of the cycles move with consumer search, though not necessarily in the same direction. Whether these cycles persist in the long run or the pricing dynamic converges to the Diamond paradox, the Bertrand paradox, or a kinked-demand equilibrium depends on exogenous conditions that we outline.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含有限理性消费者搜寻的动态定价模型。消费者观察到一种价格后，可选择进行成本性搜寻以了解其他价格，随后从提供最低观察价格的厂商处购买。每位消费者仅在观察到的价格超过其动态调整的保留价格时才会进行搜寻。厂商根据当前保留价格的分布进行优化定价。短期定价表现为埃奇沃斯循环特征。并非以混合策略重置，每个循环在拥有较大安装基数的厂商通过垄断其剩余需求而让步时结束。循环的下界与上界均随消费者搜寻行为变动，尽管变动方向未必一致。这些循环在长期内是否持续，或定价动态是否收敛于戴蒙德悖论、伯特兰悖论或弯折需求均衡，取决于我们所概述的外生条件。

title: The Yeoman's Portfolio: Measuring Historical Risk Preferences Using Crop Choice
title_zh: 《自耕农的投资组合：利用作物选择衡量历史风险偏好》
title_primary: 《自耕农的投资组合：利用作物选择衡量历史风险偏好》
title_secondary: The Yeoman's Portfolio: Measuring Historical Risk Preferences Using Crop Choice
authors: Remy Levin, Daniela Vidart
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We design a method for measuring the risk preferences of agents in the deep past. The method combines a structural model of crop choice as a portfolio allocation with machine-learning prediction of expected crop returns, using historic agronomic and climate data. We estimate county-level risk preferences for the United States and farmer-level preferences in Kansas from 1889 to 1929. More risk averse farmers leveraged less, were less likely to purchase novel WWI Liberty Bonds, and were more likely to participate in local risk-sharing institutions. We show that higher risk aversion predicts slower tractor adoption and farm mechanization during the 1920s.
abstract_zh: 我们设计了一种衡量远古时期个体风险偏好的方法。该方法将作物选择的结构性模型视为投资组合配置，并结合机器学习预测预期作物收益，利用历史农业与气候数据。我们估算了美国县级风险偏好及1889年至1929年间堪萨斯州农民个体层面的偏好。风险规避程度更高的农民杠杆使用较少，购买一战新型自由债券的可能性较低，而更倾向于参与本地风险分担机制。我们证明，更高的风险规避程度预示着20世纪20年代拖拉机采用及农业机械化进程的放缓。

title: Microfoundations of Absorptive Capacity as Revealed by Inventor Deaths
title_zh: 发明人去世所揭示的吸收能力微观基础
title_primary: 发明人去世所揭示的吸收能力微观基础
title_secondary: Microfoundations of Absorptive Capacity as Revealed by Inventor Deaths
authors: Benjamin Balsmeier, Lee Fleming, Sonja Lück
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We return to the theoretical foundations of absorptive capacity and test the idea that personal experience in a field makes it easier for a firm’s inventors to recognize and build upon knowledge in that field from other local firms. We propose a new empirical model of localized knowledge diffusion, which (1) measures a firm’s absorptive capacity by its inventors’ prior experience in a field, (2) uses a death instrument to exogenously vary the availability of knowledge of the same collaborative patent in different regions, and (3) estimates the difference in citation likelihood from all subsequent inventors across both regions as a function of a potentially citing inventor’s prior experience in the field. Consistent with the original theory of absorptive capacity, firms whose inventors have prior experience in a field are more likely to use locally available interpersonal knowledge from other firms; furthermore, this effect declines monotonically with distance. Although the effects strengthen for more recent experience and multidisciplinary knowledge, the greatest benefits accrue to firms in the interaction—those whose inventors have more recent experience and that seek to absorb multidisciplinary knowledge. Interpersonal absorptive capacity within firms does not appear to localize. This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy. Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation and the National Science Foundation [Grant 1360228]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147 .
abstract_zh: 我们回归吸收能力的理论基础，检验一个观点：个人在某一领域的经验能帮助企业发明者更容易识别并利用该领域来自其他本地企业的知识。我们提出了一种新的本地化知识扩散实证模型，该模型（1）通过发明者在某一领域的先前经验来衡量企业的吸收能力，（2）利用死亡工具来外生地变化同一合作专利在不同地区知识的可用性，以及（3）估计所有后续发明者跨地区引用可能性的差异，作为潜在引用发明者在该领域先前经验的函数。与吸收能力的原始理论一致，发明者在某一领域有先前经验的企业更有可能利用来自其他企业的本地人际知识；此外，这种效应随距离增加而单调递减。虽然对于较近期的经验和跨学科知识，这种效应会增强，但最大的收益归于处于互动中的企业——即那些发明者拥有较新近经验且寻求吸收跨学科知识的企业。企业内部的人际吸收能力似乎并未表现出本地化特征。本文已被商业策略领域的Anita McGahan接受。资助：作者感谢阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆基金会及国家科学基金会[资助号1360228]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147获取。

title: Feeding a fifth of the world under land constraints: Agricultural innovation and grain yield growth in China
title_zh: 土地约束下养活全球五分之一人口：中国的农业创新与粮食单产增长
title_primary: 土地约束下养活全球五分之一人口：中国的农业创新与粮食单产增长
title_secondary: Feeding a fifth of the world under land constraints: Agricultural innovation and grain yield growth in China
authors: Gang Wu, Jingru Chen, Sichang Luo, Changyi Jiang, Shiping Mao 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Ensuring food security under binding land constraints is a central challenge for many developing economies. Using a county-level panel dataset for China from 2000 to 2022, this study examines how agricultural technological innovation affects grain yield under land scarcity. We construct quality-adjusted patent stocks of grain-related technologies based on patent microdata and distinguish between input-oriented innovation and field-management innovation. By integrating patent data, business registration records, and official agricultural statistics, we empirically examine the effects of agricultural technological innovation on grain yield. The results show that agricultural technological innovation significantly increases grain yield: a doubling of the quality-adjusted stock of grain-related patents is associated with an approximately 1.10% increase in grain yield. However, its effects differ sharply by innovation type. Input-oriented innovation exhibits limited or even negative effects, whereas field-management innovation consistently enhances grain yield. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger yield effects in major grain-producing regions, areas with broader technological coverage and greater patent collaboration, and lower-yield counties. Mechanism analyses indicate that production organization and agricultural socialized services are key channels through which innovation translates into yield gains. Overall, the findings suggest that productivity gains in land-scarce agricultural systems depend less on input intensification than on effective production management and supportive institutional arrangements, with broader implications for other land-constrained developing economies.
abstract_zh: 在土地约束下保障粮食安全是许多发展中经济体面临的核心挑战。利用2000年至2022年中国县级面板数据，本研究考察了农业技术创新在土地稀缺条件下如何影响粮食产量。我们基于专利微观数据构建了粮食相关技术的质量调整专利存量，并区分了投入导向型创新与田间管理型创新。通过整合专利数据、企业注册记录和官方农业统计数据，我们实证检验了农业技术创新对粮食产量的影响。结果表明，农业技术创新显著提高了粮食产量：质量调整后的粮食相关专利存量翻一番，与粮食产量约1.10%的增长相关联。然而，其效应因创新类型不同而存在显著差异。投入导向型创新的效应有限甚至为负，而田间管理型创新则持续提升粮食产量。异质性分析显示，在粮食主产区、技术覆盖范围更广且专利合作更多的地区以及低产县，产量效应更为显著。机制分析表明，生产组织方式和农业社会化服务是创新转化为产量增长的关键渠道。总体而言，研究结果表明，在土地稀缺的农业系统中，生产率的提升更多依赖于有效的生产管理和支持性制度安排，而非投入集约化，这对其他土地受限的发展中经济体具有更广泛的启示意义。

title: The Risk Sensitivity of Global Liquidity Flows: Heterogeneity, Evolution and Drivers
title_zh: 全球流动性流动的风险敏感性：异质性、演变与驱动因素
title_primary: 全球流动性流动的风险敏感性：异质性、演变与驱动因素
title_secondary: The Risk Sensitivity of Global Liquidity Flows: Heterogeneity, Evolution and Drivers
authors: Avdjiev, Stefan, Gambacorta, Leonardo, Goldberg, Linda S., Schiaffi, Stefano
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The period after the Global Financial Crisis (GFC) was characterized by a considerable risk migration within global liquidity flows, away from cross-border bank lending towards international bond issuance. We show that the post-GFC shifts in the risk sensitivities of global liquidity flows are related to the tightness of the balance sheet (capital and leverage) constraints faced by international (bank and non-bank) lenders and to the migration of borrowers across funding sources. We document that the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows is higher when funding is provided by financial intermediaries that are facing greater balance sheet constraints. We also provide evidence that the post-GFC migration of borrowers from cross-border loans to international debt securities was associated with a decline in the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows to EME borrowers.
abstract_zh: 全球金融危机（GFC）之后的时期，全球流动性流动中出现了显著的风险迁移，从跨境银行贷款转向国际债券发行。我们表明，后金融危机时期全球流动性流动风险敏感性的变化，与国际（银行和非银行）贷款机构面临的资产负债表（资本和杠杆）约束的紧密度以及借款人在不同融资来源之间的迁移有关。我们记录了当资金由面临更大资产负债表约束的金融中介提供时，全球流动性流动的风险敏感性更高。我们还提供了证据表明，后金融危机时期借款人从跨境贷款向国际债务证券的迁移，与全球流动性流动对新兴市场经济体（EME）借款人风险敏感性的下降相关联。

title: Spending to Save: The Subscription Model for Eradicating Hepatitis C in Louisiana
title_zh: 支出以拯救：路易斯安那州根除丙型肝炎的订阅模式
title_primary: 支出以拯救：路易斯安那州根除丙型肝炎的订阅模式
title_secondary: Spending to Save: The Subscription Model for Eradicating Hepatitis C in Louisiana
authors: Kevin Callison, Rena M. Conti, Jonathan Gruber, Jacob Wallace
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How should payers balance fiscal sustainability with access to transformative medical technology? We study Louisiana’s 2019 Medicaid subscription model for hepatitis C (HCV), the first example of a U.S. state employing a two-part tariff to secure unlimited access to curative medicines. Using a differences-in-differences design comparing spending on beneficiaries with HCV to those with diabetes or HIV, we find that treatment volume tripled, medical spending fell, and new HCV diagnoses declined 23 percent. The state’s $37 million in incremental spending on antivirals generated $266 million in five-year savings. Innovative financing models can generate health benefits and near-term savings for payers.
abstract_zh: 支付方应如何在财政可持续性与获取变革性医疗技术之间取得平衡？我们研究了路易斯安那州2019年针对丙型肝炎（HCV）的医疗补助订阅模式，这是美国首个采用两部定价法以确保无限制获取治愈性药物的州级案例。利用双重差分设计，将丙型肝炎受益人的支出与糖尿病或HIV患者进行比较，我们发现治疗量增加了两倍，医疗支出下降，新发丙型肝炎诊断减少了23%。该州在抗病毒药物上的3300万美元增量支出，在五年内产生了2.66亿美元的节省。创新融资模式能够为支付方带来健康收益和近期成本节约。

abstract: 文化建设对于增强民众主观福祉有重要意义。本文基于网络外部性视角,利用中国家庭追踪调查与地级市博物馆数据,考察博物馆普惠化对居民幸福感的影响。研究发现,居民幸福感随博物馆供给扩大呈局部非连续跃增。当场馆数量较少时,布局较为分散,系统性福祉效应尚需网络支撑。随着供给持续扩大,当博物馆数量达到20家、服务半径达到居民可便捷抵达的合理区间时,居民幸福感显著提升。本文以“地级市博物馆数量首次达到20家”构造准自然实验,利用多期双重差分模型分析表明,博物馆普惠化使居民幸福感提升0.078个单位,主要通过增强公平感知、积累社会资本与改善心理健康三条路径实现。本文为优化文化基础设施布局、推动精神共富提供了经验依据。

title: The Cow or the Credit: Causal Relationship Between California Dairy Herd Consolidation and Anaerobic Digesters
title_zh: 奶牛还是信贷：加州奶牛群整合与厌氧消化器之间的因果关系

authors: Michael McCullough, Jarrett Hart
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The California dairy industry has experienced considerable consolidation over the past 30 years. During this period, there has also been substantial technological innovation, implementation of the state's Low Carbon Fuel Standard program, and rapid adoption of anaerobic digesters. This apparent correlation has fueled concerns that anaerobic digesters are causing consolidation. We test for a causal relationship between digesters and consolidation using synthetic differences‐in‐differences. Our findings dispute the theory that digesters are causing consolidation.
abstract_zh: 加州乳制品行业在过去30年间经历了显著的整合。在此期间，该行业还出现了大量技术创新、州低碳燃料标准项目的实施，以及厌氧消化器的迅速普及。这种表面上的相关性引发了担忧，认为厌氧消化器正在导致行业整合。我们采用合成双重差分法检验了消化器与整合之间的因果关系。我们的研究结果反驳了消化器导致整合的理论。

title: Market selection of strategic thinking types
title_zh: 战略思维类型的市场选择
title_primary: 战略思维类型的市场选择
title_secondary: Market selection of strategic thinking types
authors: Lawrence Choo, Todd R. Kaplan, Xiaoyu Zhou
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Markets are often used to allocate decision-making, from selecting voting rights of shareholders to hiring workers in the gig economy. We study how market selection can influence the composition of strategic thinking types in strategic interactions. Using auctions as the selection mechanism, we demonstrate that after-market decisions in the 𝑝 -Beauty Contest Game can result in either higher or lower numbers, depending on the incentives. Furthermore, we pinpoint the cause of differences to the market selection of strategic thinking types, rather than the decision-maker altering behaviour due to beliefs about the selection of other players. This highlights the role of institutional factors in determining “who plays the game”.
abstract_zh: 市场常被用于分配决策权，从股东投票权的选择到零工经济中工人的雇佣。我们研究市场选择如何影响战略互动中战略思维类型的构成。以拍卖作为选择机制，我们证明在p-美容竞赛游戏中的售后决策，根据激励的不同，可能导致数字更高或更低。此外，我们将差异的原因精确指向市场对战略思维类型的选择，而非决策者因对其他参与者被选情况的信念而改变行为。这凸显了制度因素在决定“谁参与游戏”中的作用。

title: When the Effects of Informational Interventions Are Driven by Salience – Evidence from School Parents in Brazil
title_zh: 当信息干预的效果由显著性驱动——来自巴西学生家长的证据
title_primary: 当信息干预的效果由显著性驱动——来自巴西学生家长的证据
title_secondary: When the Effects of Informational Interventions Are Driven by Salience – Evidence from School Parents in Brazil
authors: Lichand, Guilherme, Cunha, Nina, Madeira, Ricardo A., Bettinger, Eric
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do informational interventions work because they lead subjects to merely update beliefs in the right direction or, to a large extent, because they increase the salience of the decision they target? We randomly assign parents to either an information group, who receives text messages with weekly data on their child’s attendance and school effort, or a salience group, who receives messages that try to redirect their attention without child-specific information. While information has large impacts on attendance, test scores and grade promotion relative to the control group, outcomes in the salience group improve by at least as much.
abstract_zh: 信息干预之所以有效，是因为它们仅仅引导受试者朝正确方向更新信念，还是很大程度上因为它们提高了所针对决策的显著性？我们将家长随机分为两组：信息组每周收到关于孩子出勤和学习努力程度的短信数据，而显著性组则收到旨在引导其注意力但不包含孩子具体信息的短信。与对照组相比，信息组在出勤率、考试成绩和年级晋升方面产生了显著影响，而显著性组的结果改善幅度至少与之相当。

abstract: During the 19th century, colonial empires expanded substantially, with at their heart flourishing trade relationships between the imperial power and its colonies. Notably, imperial powers adopted distinct commercial strategies: while some pursued an ``open door'' policy, others implemented preferential tariff regimes. This paper introduces the first comprehensive dataset documenting the trade policies of the major colonial empires from 1815 to 1960. We develop a theoretical framework that identifies three central determinants of these policies: inter--imperial competition, the progressive extension of the franchise in the imperial power and variation in imperial institutional structure. We then evaluate the model's predictions using the newly assembled dataset, and find robust empirical support for its key implications.
abstract_zh: 19世纪，殖民帝国大幅扩张，其核心是帝国与其殖民地之间繁荣的贸易关系。值得注意的是，帝国列强采取了截然不同的商业策略：一些国家奉行“门户开放”政策，而另一些则实施特惠关税制度。本文首次构建了涵盖1815年至1960年主要殖民帝国贸易政策的全面数据集。我们提出了一个理论框架，识别出这些政策的三个核心决定因素：帝国间竞争、帝国本土选举权的逐步扩大以及帝国制度结构的差异。随后，我们利用新整理的数据集评估了模型的预测，并发现其关键推论得到了稳健的实证支持。

abstract: Digital financial inclusion strategies often assume that higher levels of education and financial literacy promote adoption of digital financial services by increasing trust. However, empirical evidence on how literacy interacts with trust remains limited, particularly across countries at different stages of digital ecosystem maturity. This study uses cross-sectional survey data collected from low-income individuals in Bangladesh and Indonesia (n = 2,000). We estimate multivariate regression models to examine the relationship between education, financial literacy, institutional trust, and mobile payment adoption, and apply Shapley value decomposition to assess the relative contribution of correlated explanatory factors. Theresults reveal substantial cross-country differences. In Bangladesh,both education and financial literacy are positively associated withmobile payment adoption. In Indonesia, a more digitally maturecontext, these relationships are weaker and in some cases reversed.Notably, higher levels.The findings challenge the assumption that financial literacy alone fosters digital financial inclusion. Policy efforts should complement education initiatives with stronger consumer protection, fraud prevention, and trust-building measures tailored to local contexts.
abstract_zh: 数字普惠金融策略通常假设，更高的教育水平和金融素养能够通过增强信任来促进数字金融服务的采纳。然而，关于素养如何与信任相互作用的实证证据仍然有限，尤其是在数字生态系统成熟度不同的国家之间。本研究利用从孟加拉国和印度尼西亚低收入群体中收集的横截面调查数据（样本量n=2,000），通过估计多元回归模型，考察教育、金融素养、制度信任与移动支付采纳之间的关系，并运用沙普利值分解法评估相关解释因素的相对贡献。结果显示，两国之间存在显著差异。在孟加拉国，教育和金融素养均与移动支付采纳呈正相关；而在数字生态更为成熟的印度尼西亚，这种关系较弱，甚至在某些情况下出现逆转。值得注意的是，更高水平的金融素养并未显著增强信任对采纳的促进作用。这些发现挑战了“仅凭金融素养即可推动数字金融包容”的假设。政策制定应结合教育举措，同时加强消费者保护、欺诈防范以及因地制宜的信任建设措施。

title: The effects of childhood immunization programs on health and education: micro-evidence from India

title_secondary: The effects of childhood immunization programs on health and education: micro-evidence from India
authors: Santosh Kumar Gautam
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Exploiting cohort and spatial variation in exposure to India’s Universal Immunization Program (UIP), I estimate the program’s effects on child mortality and educational attainment. The results show that UIP exposure reduced infant mortality by 0.4 percentage points and under-five mortality by 0.5 percentage points. While the program clearly improved child survival, its effects on educational outcomes were mixed, reflecting changes in the composition of surviving children. UIP exposure reduced primary school completion but increased secondary school completion. The negative effect at lower levels of schooling may reflect lower average health among marginal surviving children or a quantity–quality trade-off arising from unanticipated improvements in child survival. In contrast, the positive effect on secondary schooling may reflect improved health and human capital among children further from the margin of survival.
abstract_zh: 利用印度全民免疫计划（UIP）覆盖率的队列与空间差异，本文评估了该计划对儿童死亡率及教育成就的影响。结果显示，UIP覆盖使婴儿死亡率降低0.4个百分点，五岁以下儿童死亡率降低0.5个百分点。尽管该计划显著改善了儿童存活率，但对教育成果的影响呈现分化特征，这反映了存活儿童群体构成的变化。UIP覆盖降低了小学完成率，但提高了中学完成率。较低教育阶段的负面效应可能源于边际存活儿童的平均健康水平下降，或儿童存活率意外提升引发的数量-质量权衡。相比之下，中学教育阶段的正面效应则可能反映了远离存活临界点的儿童健康水平与人力资本的改善。

authors: Zhaohui Zhu, Jieyu Pan, Yang Huang, Chao Hu, Youliang Yan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study explores the relationship between green factory certification and corporate cash holdings. The results show that certified firms tend to increase their cash holdings. Further analyses reveal that green factory certification promotes green investment by firms, thereby increasing their cash holdings. In addition, the positive association between green factory certification and cash holdings is more pronounced among firms with weaker green innovation foundations and greater financing constraints, jointly supporting the precautionary motive for cash holdings. Moreover, this association is concentrated in firms operating in poor information environments, where the signalling benefits of certification are not effectively transmitted to stakeholders, thereby prompting cash holdings. Our analysis of the economic consequences reveals that the increased cash holdings from certification damage firm value. This negative effect manifests primarily in poor information environments. Overall, the study indicates that in poor information environments, green factory policies drive firms to hoard cash on the basis of the precautionary motive, thereby harming firm value. These findings offer vital insights for effectively implementing certification-related environmental policies, and highlight the need to improve information environments alongside advancing green factory initiatives to mitigate the potentially negative effects of such policies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了绿色工厂认证与企业现金持有之间的关系。结果表明，获得认证的企业倾向于增加现金持有量。进一步分析发现，绿色工厂认证通过促进企业绿色投资，进而提高了其现金持有水平。此外，在绿色创新基础较弱和融资约束较大的企业中，绿色工厂认证与现金持有之间的正向关联更为显著，这共同支持了现金持有的预防性动机。同时，这种关联集中于信息环境较差的企业，在这些企业中，认证的信号传递效应未能有效传达给利益相关者，从而促使企业增加现金持有。对经济后果的分析显示，认证带来的现金持有增加损害了企业价值，且这一负面效应主要出现在信息环境较差的企业中。总体而言，研究表明，在信息环境较差的背景下，绿色工厂政策促使企业基于预防性动机囤积现金，进而损害企业价值。这些发现为有效实施认证相关的环境政策提供了重要启示，并强调在推进绿色工厂建设的同时，需要改善信息环境，以缓解此类政策可能带来的负面影响。

title: Land use transformations and tenure conflicts in the Cerrado-Caatinga frontier: Evidence from Piauí, Brazil
title_zh: 塞拉多-卡廷加交界地带的土地利用转型与权属冲突：来自巴西皮奥伊州的证据
title_primary: 塞拉多-卡廷加交界地带的土地利用转型与权属冲突：来自巴西皮奥伊州的证据
title_secondary: Land use transformations and tenure conflicts in the Cerrado-Caatinga frontier: Evidence from Piauí, Brazil
authors: Giovana Mira de Espindola, Gilberto Camara, Vicente de Paula Sousa Júnior, Daihana Soledad Argibay, Rolf Simões
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Brazil’s Rural Environmental Registry (CAR), established in 2012 under the Forest Code, is a mandatory environmental cadastral system based on self-declaration of property boundaries that plays a central role in environmental enforcement, rural credit allocation, and land-use monitoring. This study develops and applies a hierarchical conflict-resolution framework to systematically identify which portions of the CAR are procedurally reliable and analytically usable for deforestation attribution and regulatory enforcement. We analyzed 310,657 CAR registrations recorded in 2025 in Piauí, Brazil, integrating them with official tenure datasets through a sequence of hierarchical rules for the Cerrado-Caatinga transition, one of the most active agribusiness frontiers. The reconstructed tenure map, derived from the hierarchical framework representing the accumulated state of all property registrations and boundary rectifications, was applied to attribute deforestation recorded between 2013 and 2023. The primary findings indicate that intra-CAR spatial overlaps were detected nearly one-third of the registered area, with boundary conflicts concentrated among larger properties along the Cerrado agribusiness frontier. In terms of deforestation, 94.20% of vegetation loss (1236,100 ha) can be attributable to identifiable actors, of which 86.60% is associated with private properties registered in CAR and official tenure datasets. The top 1% of properties ranked by cumulative deforestation account for 71.50% of total vegetation loss between 2013 and 2023, indicating a pronounced concentration of clearing among a numerically small set of landowners. Of the deforestation associated with private properties, 73.40% is classified as illegal under the Forest Code mandates applied in this analysis, with Legal Forest Reserve deficit violations representing the dominant source of non-compliance. Although over 13 million ha of native vegetation remains on private lands, Legal Reserve deficits are concentrated among large properties in the Cerrado biome, while small properties show the largest number of individual deficit records. These results demonstrate that a hierarchical analytical framework can extract procedurally reliable information from a self-declared registry, providing a scalable basis for spatially targeted enforcement, deforestation attribution, and Forest Code compliance monitoring at the subnational level.
abstract_zh: 巴西农村环境登记系统（CAR）依据《森林法》于2012年设立，是一项基于产权边界自我声明的强制性环境地籍制度，在环境执法、农村信贷分配和土地利用监测中发挥着核心作用。本研究开发并应用了一个层级化冲突解决框架，以系统识别CAR中哪些部分在程序上可靠且可用于森林砍伐归因和监管执法分析。我们分析了2025年在巴西皮奥伊州登记的310，657份CAR注册记录，通过一系列层级规则将其与官方土地权属数据集整合，研究区域覆盖塞拉多-卡廷加过渡带——这是最活跃的农业边疆之一。基于该层级框架重建的土地权属地图，反映了所有产权登记和边界修正的累积状态，被用于归因2013年至2023年间记录的森林砍伐。主要研究结果表明，CAR内部空间重叠在近三分之一的登记面积中被检测到，边界冲突集中在沿塞拉多农业边疆分布的大型地产中。在森林砍伐方面，94.20%的植被损失（1，236，100公顷）可归因于可识别的行为主体，其中86.60%与在CAR和官方土地权属数据集中注册的私人地产相关。按累计森林砍伐量排名前1%的地产占2013年至2023年总植被损失的71.50%，表明森林清除在数量上较少的地主群体中呈现显著集中。在与私人地产相关的森林砍伐中，73.40%根据本分析所适用的《森林法》规定被归类为非法，其中法定森林保护区赤字违规是主要的合规性问题来源。尽管私人土地上仍有超过1300万公顷的原生植被，但法定保护区赤字集中在塞拉多生物群落的大型地产中，而小型地产则显示出最多的个体赤字记录。这些结果表明，层级化分析框架能够从自我声明登记系统中提取程序上可靠的信息，为地方层面的空间定向执法、森林砍伐归因和《森林法》合规监测提供了可扩展的基础。

abstract: We document that in response to intensified competition from China in the U.S., poor countries reduce their export prices relative to rich countries, consistent with conventional wisdom. Interestingly, however, the opposite is true for export quantities. To reconcile these facts, we develop and estimate a general equilibrium model of trade featuring (i) cross-country heterogeneity in the ability to produce high-quality goods and (ii) a two-dimensional Bertrand competition on price and quality. Our model explains the empirical facts by showing that rich countries have a comparative advantage in quality upgrading, whereas a nested model without quality cannot do so.
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，面对中国在美国市场竞争加剧的情况，贫困国家相对于富裕国家降低了出口价格，这与传统观点一致。然而有趣的是，出口数量却呈现相反趋势。为调和这些事实，我们构建并估计了一个包含以下特征的贸易一般均衡模型：（i）各国生产高质量产品能力的异质性，以及（ii）价格与质量二维伯特兰竞争。该模型通过揭示富裕国家在质量升级方面具有比较优势来解释实证现象，而嵌套的无质量模型则无法做到这一点。

abstract: We study inference for threshold regression in the context of a large factor model with common stochastic trends. We develop a Least Squares estimator for the threshold level, deriving almost sure rates of convergence and proposing a novel way of constructing confidence intervals based on a randomized test. Our confidence intervals are constructed using the rates of convergence of the estimated threshold level, and no limiting distribution is required. We also develop a procedure to estimate the number of common trends in each regime, and investigate the properties of the Principal Component estimator for the loadings and common factors in both regimes. Our theoretical findings are corroborated through a comprehensive set of Monte Carlo experiments, and an application to equity prices and bond yields.

abstract: We examine the health effects of a labor market activation policy in Sweden, the Youth Job Guarantee. To estimate causal effects, we implement a regression discontinuity design using the policy's age-eligibility threshold, together with detailed administrative data on health-related outcomes, including indicators of mental health. Health effects could arise indirectly, via effects on employment, or directly, for example via improved daily routines. In contrast to most existing studies on the health effects of active labor market programs, our results indicate that the activation policy did not have clear positive effects on health one year after the start of unemployment, measured by prescribed medication or medical contacts.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了瑞典一项劳动力市场激活政策——“青年就业保障”对健康的影响。为估计因果效应，我们利用该政策的年龄资格门槛实施断点回归设计，并结合详细的行政数据，涵盖健康相关结果，包括心理健康指标。健康效应可能通过就业影响间接产生，或直接产生，例如通过改善日常作息。与大多数关于积极劳动力市场计划健康效应的现有研究相比，我们的结果表明，该激活政策在失业开始一年后，并未对健康产生明确的积极影响，这一结论基于处方药使用或医疗接触的测量。

abstract: This study determines the effects of green energy (GE), natural resources (NR), gross savings (GS), financial development (FD) and technological innovation (TI) on the economic growth (EG) of Pakistan by using the symmetric novel ARDL technique to identify the nexus among variables with the dynamics of short- and long-run. In order to evaluate the strength and reliability of the findings, the study also used the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) technique. Empirical findings demonstrate that natural resources, gross savings, and financial development have a substantial impact on economic growth, in both the short term and long term. However, renewable energy utilization and technological innovation have a detrimental influence on economic growth. The Pakistani government should consider conservative strategies and approaches that prioritize renewable energy and technological innovation by creating new financial incentives. The study’s findings provide specific policy suggestions for developing economies to enhance technology, innovation and financial institutions, thereby enhancing economic progress.

abstract: Numerous studies have tested Kuznets’ hypothesis of a hump-shaped relationship between inequality and industrialization by regressing the Gini coefficient on the level and square of per capita income. Here, we examine Kuznets’ original idea that inequality first increases and then declines when workers move from agriculture to manufacturing. We collect sectoral wage and employment data for 17 advanced countries over the period 1800-2020 and compute the ‘Kuznets Gini’ as the Gini coefficient that results from changes in sectoral employment shares and the sectoral wage differential. We show the hump-shaped path of the Kuznets Gini and establish, in panel regressions, that inequality arising from sectoral migration has been an important determinant of overall income inequality.
abstract_zh: 众多研究通过将基尼系数对人均收入水平及其平方项进行回归，检验了库兹涅茨关于不平等与工业化之间呈驼峰形关系的假说。在此，我们考察库兹涅茨的原始构想，即当劳动力从农业向制造业转移时，不平等先上升后下降。我们收集了17个发达国家在1800年至2020年间的部门工资和就业数据，并计算“库兹涅茨基尼系数”，该系数源于部门就业份额变化及部门工资差异。我们展示了库兹涅茨基尼系数的驼峰形路径，并通过面板回归证实，由部门迁移产生的不平等一直是总体收入不平等的重要决定因素。
